rules.new_rule: Freeze every material recommendation in the append-only decision ledger before the deadline; append outcomes later.
rules.reason: Prevent hindsight rewriting and preserve decision-time evidence.

rules.new_rule: Validate the authenticated Yahoo Sparta snapshot before any ownership-dependent recommendation; otherwise classify availability UNKNOWN.
Evaluate waiver value using winning FAAB, $1 transaction fee, points above replacement, weeks held, and value per FAAB dollar.
rules.reason: Sparta FAAB and pickup fees are real money.
rules.expected_effect: More disciplined spending and less marginal churn.

rules.new_rule: Grade outcome and process separately using information available at decision time.
rules.reason: Good process can lose and bad process can win through variance.
rules.expected_effect: Better calibration and fewer hindsight-driven changes.

rules.new_rule: Do not change signal weights or operating rules from one ordinary result; require repeated evidence unless a structural safety defect is exposed.
